app.name: Picsart AI Photo Editor, Video
app.description: All-in-one photo and video editor with AI-powered tools, filters, and a creative community.

verdict.one_liner: Collects activity data, shares with ad networks, and stores facial geometry for effects.
verdict.summary: Picsart is a feature-rich photo editor, but its privacy practices are concerning. It may store your contact list, stores facial geometry data for up to three years, and engages in interest-based advertising with third-party networks. While it offers some user controls, the breadth of data sharing and tracking earns it a low privacy score.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Picsart collects and shares data with advertisers, may store your contacts and facial geometry on its servers, and does not recognize Do Not Track signals. If privacy matters to you, consider a more privacy-focused photo editor.

red.title: Contact list uploaded to servers
red.plain_english: With your permission, Picsart states that it may access and store your device's contact list to help you find your friends on Picsart.

red.title: Facial geometry stored for years
red.plain_english: When you use face effects, Picsart states that it may use facial geometry or other facial data to produce the effect you request, and will destroy this biometric data within 3 years of account inactivity at the latest.

red.title: Interest-based ads use cross-platform data
red.plain_english: Picsart states that its Ad Network may collect information about your use of Picsart and other websites or apps over time, including across different browsers and devices, to show you personalized ads.

red.title: Broad third-party data sharing
red.plain_english: Picsart states that it shares information with ad networks, Google Analytics, Google's Crashlytics and Firebase services, and Facebook.

red.title: Ignores Do Not Track signals
red.plain_english: Picsart states that its systems do not recognize Do Not Track signals.

green.title: TrueDepth face data stays on device
green.plain_english: When using certain face effects, the raw spatial data from Apple's TrueDepth camera never leaves your device and is not stored.

green.title: Privacy request form available
green.plain_english: You can submit a request to access, correct, or delete your personal data through a dedicated online form.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The policy states that camera and TrueDepth API data may be collected for editing features, but does not mention microphone access.
categories.detail: Camera is required for core editing features. TrueDepth API spatial data stays on device, but edited content is uploaded.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you have an Apple iOS device and use the camera function with our services, we may automatically collect data about the spatial positioning of a person's head or face within an image frame using Apple's TrueDepth API.
concerns: Camera access is core to the app
Policy does not mention microphone access

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Picsart states that it approximates your location from your IP address or device settings, and that geotags on photos may be searchable if you make them public.
categories.detail: Approximate location from IP/device settings. Geotags may be stored with photos and searchable if public.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also require data about your location, which we approximate from your IP address or device settings... If you geotag your photo... the latitude and longitude coordinates may be stored with the photo and may be searchable
concerns: Geotags can expose precise location if photos are public

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you allow it, Picsart states that it may access and store your device's contact list to help you find friends on the platform.
categories.detail: Contact list is accessed and stored on servers for friend-finding and sharing. Also collected from linked social accounts.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your permission (on download or within one of our apps), we may access and store your device's contact list to help you find your friends on Picsart
concerns: Contacts stored on servers
Social account linking also pulls contact/friend data

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Picsart collects visual information through the images that you post to its services. The policy does not clearly explain whether the app continuously accesses your photo library.
categories.detail: User-initiated file selection for editing. The app does not continuously scan your library without permission, but this is not explicitly stated.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect visual information through the images that you post to our services, including your profile photos.
concerns: Edited and posted content is stored on Picsart servers

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Picsart states that it shares information with ad networks, Google Analytics, Google's Crashlytics and Firebase services, and Facebook.
categories.detail: Shares with ad networks, analytics providers, subsidiaries, and affiliates. Also shared in business transactions.
categories.policy_excerpt: Ad networks and other ad serving providers (collectively, our 'Ad Network') that serve ads on behalf of others on our platform.
concerns: Ad networks receive data for interest-based advertising
Analytics data shared with Google and Facebook

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Picsart collects your name, email, username, password, and approximate location when you create an account. The policy states that it may use collected information to market services and deliver targeted advertising, but does not clearly explain whether account identity data specifically is used for ads.
categories.detail: Account info required. General marketing use is stated but not explicitly linked to identity data. Linked to social accounts for friend-finding.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create an account we collect the information you provide us through text fields, including contact and other identifying information such as your first and last name, email address, username, and password.
concerns: Policy does not clearly explain if account data is used for ads
Linked to social media accounts for friend-finding

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Picsart states that its Ad Network may collect information about your use of Picsart and other websites or apps over time to show you interest-based ads, and that its systems do not recognize Do Not Track signals.
categories.detail: Interest-based advertising supported. Ad networks collect cross-platform data. Do Not Track not recognized. DAA opt-out available.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our Ad Network may serve ads on behalf of Picsart and others on our platform and non-affiliated platforms.
concerns: Cross-platform behavioral tracking via ad networks
Do Not Track signals are not recognized

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Children under 13 are not allowed to use Picsart. The policy states that if it becomes aware it has received personal information from a person under 13, it will delete the information and terminate the account.
categories.detail: 13+ requirement. Account deletion if underage user detected. No specific COPPA compliance details.
categories.policy_excerpt: You are not allowed to use our services if you are under the age of 13... If we become aware that we have received personal Information from a person under the age of 13, we will delete this information and terminate the person's account
concerns: Age gate relies on self-reporting

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Picsart states that its log data includes your IP address, browser type, search terms, and cookie data, which it uses to operate services and improve your experience.
categories.detail: Log data includes IP, browser, device, search terms, cookie data. Used for operations and improvement.
categories.policy_excerpt: Log data... includes your IP address, browser type and settings, the date and time of your visit, search terms, which elements of our site and services you use the most, device data, and cookie data.
concerns: IP and detailed activity logged continuously

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Picsart states that it collects and combines data about the devices you use to access Picsart, and data about your device usage and activity. It does not clearly explain whether this is used to track you across apps.
categories.detail: Device data and usage activity collected. Used for analytics and interest-based advertising. Cross-app tracking purpose is not clearly explained.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect and combine data about the devices you use to access Picsart, and data about your device usage and activity.
concerns: Device data combined across uses
Purpose for cross-app tracking not clearly explained

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: When you use face effects, Picsart states that it may use facial geometry or other facial data to produce the effect you request, and will destroy this biometric data within 3 years of account inactivity at the latest.
categories.detail: Biometric data (facial geometry) collected for effects. Stored for up to 3 years after account inactivity. Not sold.
categories.policy_excerpt: Picsart may use facial geometry or other facial data to produce the image or effect you request... within 3 years of the date your account becomes inactive.
concerns: Biometric data stored on servers for up to 3 years
Not used for identification, but still sensitive

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention financial or payment data.
categories.detail: No financial or payment information collection is mentioned in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request to delete your personal information through a privacy request form, but some data may be kept for legal or business reasons.
categories.detail: Deletion available via Privacy Request Form or email. Some data retained for legal obligations.
categories.policy_excerpt: Picsart provides you the option to delete the personal information we have collected about you... To exercise any of these rights, including to delete your data, please make a request using Picsart's Privacy Request Form
concerns: Some data may be retained after deletion request for legal reasons

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Picsart may update its privacy policy at any time. It states that material changes may be notified via its website, app, email, or push notification, and continued use constitutes agreement.
categories.detail: Changes posted to website. Material changes may be notified via website, app, email, or push. Continued use equals agreement.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we make material changes, we may notify you through other methods as required by law... If you continue to use Picsart after those changes are in effect, you agree to the new policy.
concerns: Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance
